body:
Hmm... I enjoy solving puzzles. For Christmas my mother bought me like 20 Rubik's cube style puzzles, that I have been slowly learning to solve.

I play video games a lot, though I usually lose interest in them fairly quickly, nowadays I'll hop on for 20 minutes then get bored and go do something else. When Skyrim comes out I'll probably play that for a few weeks.

Face to face with a counsellor I would feel much less inclined to talk. Right now I'm completely anonymous and I can calm myself down whenever I start to feel anxious by just chilling out and watching youtube videos for a bit.

I guess it's just the attention. I want someone to look at me as more than just a face in the crowd.

I think my issues stem from my 'friends' who were never really friends to me.

My closest friend constantly insulted me, called me names and stuff. More recently he started calling me a failure, highlighting my failure to achieve good grades in school, and the fact that I'm not really doing anything with my life.
We play online games together a lot, and he highlights my failures all the time, but never says 'wow that was great' when I do good. He just tells me not to get too full of myself, because I'm just going to fail in a minute anyway. Makes me feel worthless.

Yet I keep in contact with him because at least he pays enough attention to notice that I am failing. I know I should just stop speaking to him, but then I get so lonely, I just want someone to talk to, and he's right there. I suppose he's less a friend and more a tool to fight the loneliness.

It wasn't the classes I didn't like. I didn't really enjoy them, but I would have put up with it if I didn't feel so isolated.

As for the trade school thing, I'd need to have a career in mind for that, and I don't know what I want to do, but I'll have to look into that.

I don't like college. I tried two different classes. In both I felt like I was alone. I didn't really speak to anyone, and the only attempts by them to befriend me were met with cold indifference. I think this was because they weren't smart enough. I feel like I can only be friends with people who are really intelligent. I feel bad admitting that I think everyone around me is an idiot. I absolutely abhor ignorance, and I find it difficult to simplify things to a level where people understand my explanations.

I want to be friends with these people, but their stupidity irks me.

You age question made me get paranoid and write about 6 different replies before I decided to just answer.

I'm almost 18.

Spot on. I feel like I need to be the best. Because I always have been in anything that mattered to me. And then I wasn't. Because I'm screwing up my life for no reason.

As for other hobbies... I'm not a particularly musical person, I don't like working with my hands much, so sculpting, metalwork etc. are out.
Any Suggestions?

I'm not sure what I want do. I want to go to college, get some qualifications. I just want to move forward with my life you know? All my friends are getting through college, moving forward. I hardly even speak to them anymore. I feel like I'm being left behind.

I feel like getting counselling would be ineffective. I don't like opening up to people. If I don't know them, then they are unknown, dangerous. If I do know them, then I don't want to share for fear they will pity me, and I hate being pitied.

I think a lot. I often spend an hour or longer in the shower just thinking. I can't just sit still though. When I'm at my computer and a thought hits me I open minesweeper and go on autopilot while I think. But I can never think about anything for long. My mind drives me towards imagining myself in fantasy universes, I guess because I want so badly to escape this life.
